text:
Maya: quick syncHey team 10: moving the alert preview trigger inline under channel chips 12: instead of bottom-right. goal: keep preview visible when users toggle suppression. any major objections?
Ben: sounds fine. main worry is row height in compact lists. we can't push rows to 72px. can we use a micro-link variant?
Sam: micro-link works. suggest: compact = "Preview" text link with icon, normal = small primary button. also keep a 1-line subtitle under the rule name showing active channel count so users know which channels are in scope.
Ivy: copy nit: "Preview" is ambiguous. prefer "Preview recent alerts" or "Preview sent alerts" so it's clear what the preview contains.
Maya: lean toward "Preview recent alerts". shorter tooltip could be "Show recent alerts for selected channels".
Accessibility Bot: screenreader note: add aria-live="polite" to the preview panel load and ensure the CTA has aria-haspopup="dialog" when it opens a modal. Also add aria-label="Preview recent alerts for selected channels".
Ben: keyboard flow: current tab order goes "edit rule" -> "suppression" -> "channels" -> bottom CTA. If CTA moves up we must audit tab index so flow stays logical. proposal: channels -> CTA -> suppression -> preview toggle? feels odd. prefer: channels -> suppression -> CTA.
Sam: agree keep suppression before CTA so keyboard users can toggle suppression and then preview the result without extra tabbing.
Ivy: visual hint: when suppression is enabled show a dimmed mute icon next to channels and add small text "(suppressed)" in the preview subtitle. avoids "why am i seeing nothing" confusion.
Maya: analytics: fire an event payload like: {"event":"preview.open","rule_id":"r_123","channels":["pagerduty","email"],"suppressed":true}. Add a boolean "preview_nonempty" when results returned >0.
Ben: implementation detail: for compact mode we should lazy-load preview data only after click to avoid extra latency for list rendering. also cache last successful preview per rule for 30s.
Sam: dev note: if preview opens as popover avoid focus trap; if it's a modal trap focus. popover should shift focus to the panel but restore to CTA on close.
Accessibility Bot: color contrast check: inline link must be >=4.5:1 for 12px body; if we keep small text must use 16px or use stronger color token. focus outline should be 3:1 with immediate background.
Ivy: copy for tooltip when suppression on: "Includes suppressed channels (Preview may show fewer alerts)". small enough?
Maya: works. let's also add a transient hint after first preview: tooltip "Press P to open preview" for power users (dismiss after 1 use).
Ben: I'll prototype compact link + icon and add keyboard tests. Sam please add aria attributes in component and handle focus restore.
Sam: on it. pushing a tiny demo to storybook. link in PR.
Maya: thanks. I'll update Figma with the compact/expanded variants and copy changes. adding a checklist to the PR template: keyboard tab order, color contrast, screenreader announce on load. :white_check_mark:
